payload.title: Formal low-rank scan steps 6 and 7 completed as fail-closed gates
payload.top_notice: Step 6 and step 7 are complete only in the fail-closed sense under the current partial catalog: the scan-plan generator rejects the v10 catalog because six non-pointed rows remain blocked, and the control runner gate rejects S4/CP2/S2xS2/unlink-Hopf/alpha=0 controls because no formal scan plan exists. No scan plan, scan case result, control result, aggregate, or no-signal claim is produced.
validated_behaviors: Step 6 scan-plan generation attempt records formal_scan_plan_produced=false, formal_scan_plan_hash=null, and scan_case_ids=[].

Step 6 blocked reasons include catalog-status-is-not-established, catalog-formal-scan-plan-allowed-is-false, readiness-scan-plan-generation-allowed-is-false, catalog-has-blocked-family-rows, and ribbon-denominator-is-not-final.
Step 7 control attempt records formal_scan_case_results_produced=false and control_case_results=[].
S4, CP2, S2xS2, unlink/Hopf, and alpha=0 controls are recorded as NOT_RUN_NO_FORMAL_SCAN_PLAN rather than fake PASS results.
The blocked attempt artifacts are rejected by validate_formal_evidence as unsupported formal evidence kinds.
The gate summary records scan_plan=null, scan_case_results=[], and scan_aggregate=null.
